title: EVERGLADES CITY OUTLAWS
description:
This documentary covers: July 7, 1983: 'Operation Everglades‘ A major drug raid shakes Everglades City. In a dramatic pre-dawn operation, 28 individuals were taken into custody, and over half of the town's fishing vessels were confiscated. The action involved around 200 federal drug enforcement agents working alongside Collier County sheriff's deputies.
